description: Diagram of a Trickling filter process showing a circular tank filled with filtering medium (broken bricks/crushed rocks). Labeled parts include: Effluent from primary treatment entering from the left, a central vertical pipe with Rotary arms at the top, air flow arrows pointing up and down through the filtering media, treated effluent flowing to a settling tank on the right with a chlorination arrow pointing down, an Effluent output, and a Sludge output at the bottom of the settling tank.
author: Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology Technical drawings: designport, Paolo Monaco, Zurich See http://ecompendium.sswm.info/copyright

review.shows: A detailed diagram of a trickling filter system showing filtering medium, sprinklers, feed pipe, air flow, and outlet collection.
problems: The secondary settling tank and chlorination steps are not fully detailed in this specific crop/version of the diagram, focusing primarily on the filter bed itself.

title: Trickling Filter diagram
